sql.if: INNER JOIN ( SELECT FIL_UL.PARTY_ID AS UL_PARTY_ID, FIL_ULVR.USER_LOGIN_ID AS ULVR_USER_LOGIN_ID, FIL_ULVR.PARTY_ID AS ULVR_PARTY_ID, FIL_ULVR.ROLE_TYPE_ID AS ULVR_ROLE_TYPE_ID FROM USER_LOGIN_VALID_PARTY_ROLE FIL_ULVR INNER JOIN USER_LOGIN FIL_UL ON FIL_ULVR.USER_LOGIN_ID = FIL_UL.USER_LOGIN_ID) FIL_U ON FIL_W.ORGANIZATION_ID = FIL_U.ULVR_PARTY_ID AND FIL_U.ULVR_ROLE_TYPE_ID = 'INTERNAL_ORGANIZATIO'

INNER JOIN WORK_EFFORT_TYPE FIL_WT ON FIL_WT.WORK_EFFORT_TYPE_ID = FIL_W.WORK_EFFORT_TYPE_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN PARTY_RELATIONSHIP FIL_PRM ON FIL_W.ORG_UNIT_ROLE_TYPE_ID = FIL_PRM.ROLE_TYPE_ID_FROM AND FIL_W.ORG_UNIT_ID = FIL_PRM.PARTY_ID_FROM AND (FIL_PRM.PARTY_RELATIONSHIP_TYPE_ID = 'ORG_RESPONSIBLE' OR (FIL_PRM.PARTY_RELATIONSHIP_TYPE_ID = 'ORG_DELEGATE' AND (FIL_PRM.CTX_ENABLED IS NULL OR FIL_PRM.CTX_ENABLED LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(FIL_WT.PARENT_TYPE_ID, '%')) ) ) )
AND FIL_PRM.FROM_DATE <= FIL_W.ESTIMATED_COMPLETION_DATE AND (FIL_PRM.THRU_DATE IS NULL OR FIL_PRM.THRU_DATE >= FIL_W.ESTIMATED_COMPLETION_DATE) AND FIL_PRM.PARTY_ID_TO = FIL_U.UL_PARTY_ID
LEFT OUTER JOIN PARTY_RELATIONSHIP FIL_PRS ON FIL_W.ORG_UNIT_ROLE_TYPE_ID = FIL_PRS.ROLE_TYPE_ID_TO AND FIL_W.ORG_UNIT_ID = FIL_PRS.PARTY_ID_TO AND FIL_PRS.PARTY_RELATIONSHIP_TYPE_ID = 'GROUP_ROLLUP' AND FIL_PRS.FROM_DATE <= FIL_W.ESTIMATED_COMPLETION_DATE AND (FIL_PRS.THRU_DATE IS NULL OR FIL_PRS.THRU_DATE >= FIL_W.ESTIMATED_COMPLETION_DATE)
LEFT OUTER JOIN PARTY_RELATIONSHIP FIL_PRS2 ON FIL_PRS.ROLE_TYPE_ID_FROM = FIL_PRS2.ROLE_TYPE_ID_FROM AND FIL_PRS.PARTY_ID_FROM = FIL_PRS2.PARTY_ID_FROM AND (FIL_PRS2.PARTY_RELATIONSHIP_TYPE_ID = 'ORG_RESPONSIBLE' OR (FIL_PRS2.PARTY_RELATIONSHIP_TYPE_ID = 'ORG_DELEGATE' AND (FIL_PRS2.CTX_ENABLED IS NULL OR FIL_PRS2.CTX_ENABLED LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(FIL_WT.PARENT_TYPE_ID, '%')) ) ) ) AND FIL_PRS2.FROM_DATE <= FIL_W.ESTIMATED_COMPLETION_DATE AND (FIL_PRS2.THRU_DATE IS NULL OR FIL_PRS2.THRU_DATE >= FIL_W.ESTIMATED_COMPLETION_DATE) AND FIL_PRS2.PARTY_ID_TO = FIL_U.UL_PARTY_ID
LEFT OUTER JOIN PARTY_RELATIONSHIP FIL_Z2 ON FIL_PRS.ROLE_TYPE_ID_FROM = FIL_Z2.ROLE_TYPE_ID_TO AND FIL_PRS.PARTY_ID_FROM = FIL_Z2.PARTY_ID_TO AND FIL_Z2.PARTY_RELATIONSHIP_TYPE_ID = 'GROUP_ROLLUP' AND FIL_Z2.FROM_DATE <= FIL_W.ESTIMATED_COMPLETION_DATE AND (FIL_Z2.THRU_DATE IS NULL OR FIL_Z2.THRU_DATE >= FIL_W.ESTIMATED_COMPLETION_DATE)
LEFT OUTER JOIN PARTY_RELATIONSHIP FIL_Y2 ON FIL_Z2.ROLE_TYPE_ID_FROM = FIL_Y2.ROLE_TYPE_ID_FROM AND FIL_Z2.PARTY_ID_FROM = FIL_Y2.PARTY_ID_FROM AND (FIL_Y2.PARTY_RELATIONSHIP_TYPE_ID = 'ORG_RESPONSIBLE' OR (FIL_Y2.PARTY_RELATIONSHIP_TYPE_ID = 'ORG_DELEGATE' AND (FIL_Y2.CTX_ENABLED IS NULL OR FIL_Y2.CTX_ENABLED LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(FIL_WT.PARENT_TYPE_ID, '%')) ) ) ) AND FIL_Y2.FROM_DATE <= FIL_W.ESTIMATED_COMPLETION_DATE AND (FIL_Y2.THRU_DATE IS NULL OR FIL_Y2.THRU_DATE >= FIL_W.ESTIMATED_COMPLETION_DATE) AND FIL_Y2.PARTY_ID_TO = FIL_U.UL_PARTY_ID
LEFT OUTER JOIN WORK_EFFORT_PARTY_ASSIGNMENT FIL_WEPA ON FIL_W.WORK_EFFORT_ID = FIL_WEPA.WORK_EFFORT_ID AND FIL_W.ESTIMATED_COMPLETION_DATE = FIL_WEPA.THRU_DATE AND FIL_WEPA.ROLE_TYPE_ID LIKE 'WEM%' AND FIL_WEPA.PARTY_ID = FIL_U.UL_PARTY_ID

sql.if:
INNER JOIN PARTY_RELATIONSHIP UO ON UO.PARTY_ID_TO = ${aliasParty}.PARTY_ID AND UO.PARTY_RELATIONSHIP_TYPE_ID = 'ORG_EMPLOYMENT' AND UO.THRU_DATE IS NULL INNER JOIN USER_LOGIN UL ON UL.USER_LOGIN_ID = #{userLoginId}
WHERE 1=1
AND E.PARTY_ID_TO IS NOT NULL
AND Y.PARTY_ID_TO IS NOT NULL
AND UL.PARTY_ID = ${aliasParty}.PARTY_ID
AND Y2.PARTY_ID_TO IS NOT NULL

mapper.sql: LEFT JOIN PARTY_RELATIONSHIP ${aliasPR} ON ${aliasPR}.ROLE_TYPE_ID_FROM = ${aliasTabConcat}.ROLE_TYPE_ID_FROM AND ${aliasPR}.PARTY_ID_FROM = ${aliasTabConcat}.PARTY_ID_FROM AND ( ${aliasPR}.PARTY_RELATIONSHIP_TYPE_ID = 'ORG_RESPONSIBLE' OR ( ${aliasPR}.PARTY_RELATIONSHIP_TYPE_ID = 'ORG_DELEGATE' AND ( ${aliasPR}.CTX_ENABLED IS NULL OR ${aliasPR}.CTX_ENABLED LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{parentTypeId}, '%'))) ) ) AND ${aliasPR}.THRU_DATE IS NULL AND ${aliasPR}.PARTY_ID_TO = ${aliasUserLogin}.PARTY_ID

LEFT JOIN PARTY_RELATIONSHIP ${aliasPR} ON ${aliasPR}.ROLE_TYPE_ID_TO = ${aliasTabConcat}.ROLE_TYPE_ID_FROM AND ${aliasPR}.PARTY_ID_TO = ${aliasTabConcat}.PARTY_ID_FROM AND ${aliasPR}.PARTY_RELATIONSHIP_TYPE_ID = 'GROUP_ROLLUP' AND ${aliasPR}.THRU_DATE IS NULL

INNER JOIN USER_LOGIN UL ON UL.USER_LOGIN_ID = #{userLoginId} LEFT JOIN PARTY_RELATIONSHIP E ON E.ROLE_TYPE_ID_FROM = ${aliasPartyRole}.ROLE_TYPE_ID AND E.PARTY_ID_FROM = ${aliasPartyRole}.PARTY_ID AND ( E.PARTY_RELATIONSHIP_TYPE_ID = 'ORG_RESPONSIBLE' OR ( E.PARTY_RELATIONSHIP_TYPE_ID = 'ORG_DELEGATE' AND ( E.CTX_ENABLED IS NULL OR E.CTX_ENABLED LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{parentTypeId}, '%'))) ) ) AND E.THRU_DATE IS NULL AND E.PARTY_ID_TO = UL.PARTY_ID
LEFT JOIN PARTY_RELATIONSHIP Z ON Z.ROLE_TYPE_ID_TO = ${aliasPartyRole}.ROLE_TYPE_ID AND Z.PARTY_ID_TO = ${aliasPartyRole}.PARTY_ID AND Z.PARTY_RELATIONSHIP_TYPE_ID = 'GROUP_ROLLUP' AND Z.THRU_DATE IS NULL
WHERE (
1=1
E.PARTY_ID_TO IS NOT NULL
OR
Y.PARTY_ID_TO IS NOT NULL
OR
Y2.PARTY_ID_TO IS NOT NULL
OR
UL.PARTY_ID = ${aliasPartyRole}.PARTY_ID
)
